only the west line is drawn; it stops short of the river bank (east side is the Public Landing)

notes: Walnut on the west, Main on the east. Reynolds (printed REYNOLDS only, 20') runs from E. 2nd (continuing north onto sheet 112) south to E. Front, where it ends; recorded as Reynolds Street. Commerce Street (printed faintly as COMMERCE west of Walnut) ends at Walnut from the west; its east side is solid. Unnamed 10' alley runs from Walnut to Reynolds behind the E. Front lots. South of E. Water, Giffin (40') runs from Walnut to Main, slanting up to the east and curving slightly (slope about -0.1 overall, about -0.17 near Main); E. Water and Giffin both end at Main because the area east of Main south of Front is the Public Landing (sheet 103), so Main has only its west line drawn there and its centre is taken 113 px (33 ft) east of that line. Main's centreline drifts about 20 px east between 2nd and Water on this scan. The 400' figure printed along Main near Giffin is not a street width. At E. 2nd the alley continuing north (sheet 112, about 30 ft wide) is centred about x 2097 and Reynolds south of 2nd about x 2091; the crossing point is their average.
